description: TalkBack-style screen search: press NVDA+Alt+Q, type part of a control's name, and jump straight to it. Searches only what is visible in the current window, or only the open dialog or menu.
changelog:
* Works with NVDA 2026.1 and 2026.2, including 64-bit NVDA.
* Fixed: results could include controls from other windows behind the current one, because the add-on could not read the current window's position. It now searches only the window you are in (or only the open dialog or menu).
